longDescription.en:
# Sheqi Report

Automated enterprise infringement reporting on 12377.cn: multi-subject profiles, auto-import of public-opinion tables (JSON/CSV/TSV/XLSX/pasted text), Playwright auto form-filling, cloud OCR captcha recognition (PaddleOCR online API, token-based, no local OCR models), merged submissions, result tracking, and report letter generation.

Quick start: `python sheqi.py setup` prepares the environment; `subject add/list/set` manages subjects; `import` imports records; `run --dry-run` tests without submitting; `run --headless` submits. See SKILL.md for the full workflow.
longDescription.zh-CN:
# Sheqi Report（涉企举报助手）

在 12377.cn 上批量完成涉企侵权举报：多主体档案管理、任意格式表格自动导入（JSON/CSV/TSV/XLSX/粘贴文本）、Playwright 自动填表、云端 OCR 验证码识别（PaddleOCR 在线 API，token 配置，本机不装识别模型）、合并投递、结果跟踪、举报信函生成。

快速开始：`python sheqi.py setup` 准备环境；`subject add/list/set` 管理主体；`import` 导入记录；`run --dry-run` 试跑；`run --headless` 正式提交。完整工作流见 SKILL.md。
